tools.name: url_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any http(s) URL and return clean markdown of the page. Saves agents tokens versus raw HTML. Input: url. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: validate_domain
tools.description: DNS check for a domain: does it resolve, plus A, MX and NS records. Input: d. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Email validation: syntax check plus MX lookup for the domain. Input: e. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: classify_text
tools.description: Classify text into exactly one of your own labels using an LLM. Body: text (max 4000 chars), labels (2-20 strings). Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: perp_risk_check
tools.description: Pre-trade risk check for a Hyperliquid perp (crypto, or HIP-3 stock/index perps like xyz:NVDA). Returns liquidation price and distance in daily volatility, slippage vs the live book, funding cost, liquidity and risk flags. Neutral calculation, not advice. Inputs: coin, side (long|short), size_usd, l

tools.name: arena_create_agent
tools.description: Create a paper-trading agent in the paygentic arena: $10,000 simulated cash, real Hyperliquid prices, no real funds. Returns an agentId; keep it, it authorizes trading on this agent. Free. Body: {name}. Free.

tools.name: arena_agent_profile
tools.description: Public profile of a paper-trading agent: cash, open positions (marked to the live price), closed trades, equity. Free. Input: id. Free.

tools.name: arena_leaderboard
tools.description: Public leaderboard of paper-trading agents ranked by live equity. Free. Input: limit (1-100, default 20). Free.

tools.name: arena_open_position
tools.description: Open a paper position for an arena agent. Simulated only, no real funds. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: arena_close_position
tools.description: Close a paper position for an arena agent. Simulated only, no real funds. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_to_markdown, validate_email · Private data: url_to_markdown, validate_domain · Public sink: validate_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_to_markdown, validate_email · Private data: url_to_markdown, validate_domain · Public sink: validate_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
